sh: jagged grey peak with snowy cap
f: Rises out of the ground. Rude, but effective.

sh: sheer rock wall with a ledge
deep red rock gash with layered walls
f: Mind the drop. It is a long one.
Flat on top. Steep everywhere else.
Surrounded by water. And sharks, probably.

sh: black rock island with smoking peak

f: Sun, sand, and a surprise attack.

sh: rolling dunes under a blazing sun
f: Hot. Dry. Sand in every pocket.
Walk two steps. Slide one back.

sh: palm trees around a blue pond

f: Something is watching from the vines.

sh: crowd of tall trees, dappled light
f: Lots of trees. All of them on your side.
Do not go in after dark. It is always dark.

sh: rows of tall dark pines in snow
f: Smells like a holiday. Fights like a winter.

sh: murky green water, reeds, gnarled trees
f: Squelch. Squelch. You are stuck now.

sh: mossy cypress trees, still dark water
f: Gators live here. So does trouble.
Pigs love it. Enemies do not.
Dark, damp, and full of echoes.

sh: cavern lined with giant glowing crystals
still black lake in a cavern
huge cracked river of blue-white ice
endless snow and ice, aurora sky
f: Brrrr. Bring a coat. Bring three.

sh: rows of trellised grapevines on a slope
neat beds of flowers and veggies
f: Weeding in progress. Enemies are weeds.

sh: raked gravel swirls, a few stones
tall square hedges in winding paths

f: Every way is the wrong way.

sh: sandy round pit ringed by walls
oval stands around a bright pitch

f: Bones to the left. Bones to the right.

sh: long red carpet to a golden throne
f: All rise for the royal smackdown.

sh: piles of gold coins and gems
f: Look at all this loot! Nobody touch it.
Do not read the scroll aloud.

sh: overgrown stone city with golden domes
f: Nobody has found it. Except you, now.
Sank long ago. Holding a grudge.

sh: grassy rock floating in the sky
f: No roads. Just a long way down.
Up in the clouds, everything is soft. Except you.
All of this could be yours.

sh: cluster of cottages and a well

f: Nobody here. Just you and the tumbleweed.

sh: houses on a harbour with boats

f: Fun for the whole family. Dizzy for enemies.
Splash zone. Everyone is in it.

sh: piles of rusty cars and scrap

f: Hard hats required. Enemies, not provided.
Already full of craters. Add more.

sh: round dented bowl with a rocky rim
tall rock with foaming white falls
f: It never stops. Neither will we.
Goes with the flow. You go with it.
Calm on top. Hmm, what is below?
Down here, the lights have teeth.

sh: narrow deep sea channel between cliffs
f: Very deep. Very cold. Very pretty.
Water on three sides. Trouble on the fourth.
Lots of tiny islands. Lots of tiny problems.

sh: ring of sand around a turquoise lagoon

f: So flat you can see tomorrow.

sh: black crust cracking over glowing lava

f: Spores everywhere. Breathe at your own risk.
Everything is edible. Even the hills.
Tall, green, and full of hiding pandas.

sh: colossal red trunks into the clouds
f: So tall you can not see the tops.

sh: dusty main street, general store, cactus
red dirt, scrub, one lonely tree
domes and antennas on grey dust
dark cavern realm, rivers of fire

f: Lights in the fog. Do not follow them.
Drops the tallest mountain on Earth. Bit much.
The gods are watching. And throwing lightning.

sh: wide volcanic mountain with a snowy top
f: Snow on the equator. Showing off.
Very grand. Very canyon. Very far down.
Sand. Then more sand. Then a sandstorm.

sh: endless colourful coral under clear sea
flat turquoise lake with white salt edges
f: You cannot sink. You can float forever.
Floods once a year. Right now, actually.

sh: huge brown river through dense jungle
huge rounded red rock in flat desert
f: One rock. Very large. Very red.
Hottest place around. Bring water. Lots.

sh: long dark Scottish lake in hills
stormy sea with a glowing triangle
f: Ships go in. Ships do not come out.
Every brick is gold. Every enemy is distracted.

sh: hidden green valley with golden temples
f: Nobody ages here. Nobody loses here.
Shrouded in mist. Full of healing.
The feast never ends. Neither does the fight.

sh: golden city on a floating rock
smoky cave piled with gold and bones
f: Something big is sleeping on that gold.

sh: crude cave with spears and junk
f: Hundreds of tiny footsteps. Uh oh.

sh: hidden bay with a moored pirate ship
island with an X marked in sand
castle with spires, owls, floating candles
f: Class is in session. Lesson one: fireballs.
Muahaha. Welcome. Please mind the sharks.

sh: castle of lollipops, gumdrops and icing
f: Edible walls. Enemies keep stopping to snack.

sh: burning plains under a red sky
inky void with floating dark rocks
f: Everything is dark. Everything is watching.

sh: giant blocks, wind-up soldiers, toy trains
f: The toys come alive. All of them.
Left is right. Right is wrong.

sh: sharp rocky spine of a hill
f: Walk the ridge. Do not wobble.
Only one way through. Guard it.

sh: knobbly stack of rocks on a hill
f: Good spot to stand and shout.

sh: rock arch with waves crashing through
f: Waves boom through it. Mind your head.
Tiny ocean. Tiny crabs. Big pinch.

sh: low strip of sand in shallow water
towering white ice cliff over sea
jagged mountain top under deep snow
rolling hills of heather and mist
endless flat grass under huge sky
f: Flat as far as you can see. Great for charging.
Fog so thick you cannot see your feet.

sh: stone tree trunks lying in desert
f: Trees turned to stone. Do not stare too long.
Lost in the corn. Something rustles.

sh: grass, trees, benches, a duck pond
f: Lovely spot for a picnic. And an ambush.

sh: lawn with a fence and a grill
f: Barbecue in progress. Do not interrupt.

sh: flat roof with vents and antennas
dusty slanted room full of boxes
dark room under the house with one bulb
f: Do not go down there. You went down there.

sh: dark chamber with a huge throne
stone hall with spikes in walls
huge round boulder thundering down a tunnel

f: Hot rocks. Hot floor. Hot everything.

Up where the wind gods live.
Hot inside. Hotter in the boss room.

sh: carved ice halls with frosty statues
black temple lit by purple flames
ring of ancient trees around a stone
tarmac yard with hopscotch and hoops
tangle of tracks and parked wagons

f: Launches a fresh ship. At you.
One person's trash is another's weapon.
Every plant here fights for you.

sh: grey round pebbles and crashing waves
f: Crunchy underfoot. Painful to fall on.

sh: grassy edge above a sheer drop
f: One step back. No, the other way.

sh: still blue lake ringed by peaks
endless fluffy clouds under a sunset
cauldron of gold at a rainbow's end
f: Finally found it. So did the enemies.

sh: huge sprawl of land with mountains

f: Lions, deserts, and very big rivers.
Everything here wants to bite you.
The roof of the world. Mind your head.
Rocky by name. Rocky by nature.
Lungs of the planet. Also full of piranhas.
Hot days. Cold nights. Weird trees.
